name: Default
shortDescription: UX prototyping and usability testing tool with a Node.js web app, Java backend, collaboration websocket server and MongoDB.

alerts.message: Sign-up is open to anyone who can reach the domain. After creating your accounts, set QUX_USER_ALLOW_SIGNUP to false or limit QUX_USER_ALLOWED_DOMAINS to your email domains. Password resets and invitations need an SMTP server in the QUX_MAIL_* variables.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
